resources.description: Use when asked to add a field to a form, capture extra information on a document, or put a new field on a DocType such as Delivery Note or Sales Invoice.
resources.name: Adding a Custom Field

resources.description: Attaching a file the user uploaded in chat to a document by its File ID, without moving another record's file
resources.name: How to Use attach_chat_file

resources.description: Use when asked to require approval before a document is submitted, add an approval step or an amount threshold ("approval needed above ₹50,000"), or change who approves what.
resources.name: Setting Up an Approval Workflow

tools.description: Retrieve a specific Frappe document by its name/ID, with its child tables. Empty fields are left out, so a field that is missing is empty. Pass fields to get only those fields.

fields.description: Only these fields (a child table's fieldname returns its rows). Omit for all.

name.description: The document name/ID (e.g., 'CUST-00001', 'SINV-00001'). This is the unique identifier for the document.

tools.name: get_document
